system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"are you able yo buy premium with Google Play Rewards? If not, can you please make it so you can?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! You can use Google Play Rewards to purchase Spotify Premium, but if you're having trouble, feel free to DM us your account details and we'll help you out! Keep us posted /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply is informal and asks for account details publicly; needs safer, clearer wording."}
